description: This file defines the TimeConfigPeriod class within the OrangeHRM Time module, providing getter and setter methods for a startDay property, and serves as a data transfer object (DTO) for time configuration periods.

classes.name: TimeConfigPeriod
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that encapsulates the configuration for a time period, specifically containing a start day property.

methods.name: getStartDay
methods.description: Retrieves the start day of the time configuration period.

methods.name: setStartDay
methods.description: Sets the start day of the time configuration period.
